data.one_liner: A GraphQL link for package:graphql that manages authentication tokens transparently.
data.what_it_does: Provides a GraphQL link that automatically attaches authentication tokens, proactively or reactively refreshes expired tokens, retries failed requests, and manages authentication states via a stream.
use_when: You are using package:graphql and need automated token refresh on unauthenticated errors.
You want to handle single-flight requests so concurrent token refreshes don't duplicate calls.
avoid_when: You are building a REST API client instead of GraphQL (use fresh or dio instead).
You do not use token-based authentication.
strengths: Single-flight token refresh prevents concurrent duplicate refresh requests.
Provides an authenticationStatus stream for clean reactive navigation or login state management.
Supports custom token formats and pluggable storage layers.
weaknesses: Requires custom implementation of token persistence (TokenStorage) for long-term storage.
Tied directly to package:graphql link architecture.
data.setup_notes: Implement TokenStorage to save tokens persistently across app restarts and plug FreshLink into your GraphQL Link chain.

alternatives.name: oauth2
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need an OAuth2 client for REST APIs instead of GraphQL.
